description: Get the caller's saved portfolios, and those colleagues shared with the caller's organization, including stock and option lots, cost basis, realized and unrealized profit, and watched instruments. Omit portfolio to list portfolios; if exactly one exists it is returned in full. Pass its name to select one; a shared portfolio whose name is also taken is named "Name (Creator)" in the list. Quantities are signed; costs are the owner's per-share inputs and are never split-restated. Every mark names its session. Unpriceable and expired positions have unknown value, never zero. Watched instruments are not positions and must not be counted as exposure. Returned lot ids address the update, close and remove tools. Use GetInstitutionPortfolio for 13F holdings.

portfolio.description: Optional. The portfolio's name, as listed. Omit to list the portfolios.

name: GetMyPortfolio
title: My Portfolio
